g.text: Here you can disable certain project features in order to reduce the compiled build size.
Here you can enable compiler options via a comma-delimited list of flags that will be applied to built executables.
NOTE: If you enable targeting for a specific CPU architecture feature, your software will not run on any CPU that does not support that feature.
Here you can enable compiler options via a comma-delimited list of flags that will be applied to the IDE environment.
